title: BNCI 2015-007 Motion VEP (mVEP) Speller dataset
description: EEG recordings from 16 healthy, BCI-naive participants using a motion visual evoked potential (mVEP) speller for gaze-independent communication. Three Cake Speller variants were tested (overt, covert, and Motion Center), each with a two-level selection of 30 symbols. The recordings were made in practice, calibration, copy-spelling, and free-spelling sessions and capture N200 and P300 responses to target and non-target motion stimuli.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with 63 active electrodes (actiCap, BrainAmp amplifier, 10-10 montage, linked-mastoid reference). Data were downsampled to 100 Hz for the released dataset (offline analysis used 200 Hz in the original study). Stimuli were presented with a 200 ms SOA (266 ms for the Motion Center Speller) and 10 repetitions per level. Preprocessing included downsampling, low-pass filtering, baseline correction, and artifact rejection (min-max criterion of 70 μV). Classification used shrinkage LDA on features from signed squared point-biserial correlation coefficients.
